question: Which of these sentences best describe the ongoing action(s) in the video 1?
choices: Squeeze the sponge over the strainer of the kitchen sink to get rid of the excess soap in it.
Squeeze the sponge around the edge of the pan to clean.
Squeeze out the sponge in the right hand to remove any excess water from it.
Squeeze the sponge onto the tongs to clean them.
Squeeze the sponge and clean the inside of the metallic tumbler held in the left hand by rotating the sponge inside the tumbler.
correct_answer: Squeeze out the sponge in the right hand to remove any excess water from it.
